title: Units on a Wrong-Cushion Reship (PAP Supply Replenishment Program)
content:
**Clause.** A no-charge reship of the fitting cushion item under the PAP Supply Replenishment Program reships the same item count as the line it replaces: the replaced line's own monthly rate times the months counted from a start date to the replaced line's covered-through date, the start date being the replaced line's ship date and the months being the whole calendar months between the two dates plus one for the month the start date falls in. The months a line covered are the whole calendar months from its ship date to its covered-through date, plus one for the month it began in, and its monthly rate is its units divided by those months. The units reshipped are the monthly rate multiplied by the months counted, rounded to the nearest whole unit with a half rounding up.

## Definitions

- **The replaced line:** the newest coverage-billed line, by ship date, of a cushion item that does not fit the mask style recorded on the enrollment (of the two cushion items other than the fitting one, whichever shipped most recently).
- **The fitting cushion item:** the full face mask cushion (A7031) for a full face style, the nasal mask cushion (A7032) for a nasal style, and the nasal pillows pair (A7033) for a nasal pillows style.
- **Months counted:** the whole calendar months from the start date (the replaced line's ship date) to the replaced line's covered-through date, plus one for the month the start date falls in.
- **Monthly rate of a line:** its units divided by the months it covered.

## Worked example (hypothetical line)

The replaced line shipped 6 units of nasal cushions on 5 January with a covered-through date of 4 April.

| Step | Figure |
|---|---|
| months the line covered: whole calendar months from 5 January to 4 April, plus one | 2 plus 1, which is 3 |
| monthly rate: 6 units divided by 3 months | 2 a month |
| months counted from the start date, 5 January, to 4 April: whole months plus one | 3 |
| units: 2 a month multiplied by 3 months | 6 |
| rounded to the nearest whole unit, a half rounding up | 6 |

A replaced line of 1 unit shipped 10 June, covered through 9 July: whole months from 10 June to 9 July are 0, plus one is 1; rate 1 a month; months counted 1; units 1.
